item.tib: spyi 'dul rta dbu dmar chung gi tshogs kyi shog chung
item.coloph: khro rgyal rak+sha spyi 'dul gyi tshogs las nyung la don 'dus pa 'di sum pa lha'i rgyud 'dzin rin chen rnam rgyal gyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ kyu ra ba rtogs ldan bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ dpal ldan bzang ri lhun grub mthong smon du sbyar ba'o/ rjes 'jug sgrub gshen rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig/
